question: Which age group is typically considered as the working-age population in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**15-59 years**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The working population in India, also known as the working-age population, is generally considered to be the age group between 15 and 59 years.
